hero.highlight: Optimizes information systems for decision making and business competitiveness
hero.title: Professional Technician in Information Systems Operation
hero.description: Trains trained technicians to operate, maintain and support information systems, guaranteeing their availability, security and support for users in business environments.
hero.supportText: MEN Price: $2,701,000 • Tec Subsidy: $1,215,000 • Registration Value: $1,486,000

whyStudy.title: Why study Information Systems Operation?
whyStudy.description: Develop technical and practical skills to ensure the effective operation of systems and networks, resolve incidents, manage databases, and support users in digital business environments.

items.title: Practical and applied training
items.description: Contents aimed at the operation, maintenance and support of hardware, software and networks to respond to real needs of the business environment.

items.title: Competencies in support and user service
items.description: Learn to manage computer incidents, service protocols and effective customer service.

items.title: Information management and security
items.description: Training in database management, implementation of updates and practices to protect information.

items.title: Salidas laborales inmediatas
items.description: Training to work as a help desk technician, software installer, ICT support services operator or technological entrepreneur.

items.title: Flexible virtual mode
items.description: Study in virtual mode with content and support to adapt it to your pace and availability.

items.title: Admissions counseling
items.description: Support in the registration process, document review and follow-up until acceptance.

items.title: Relevant technical competencies
items.description: Training in administration of operating systems, networks, software support and databases.

items.title: Preparation for the labor market
